text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD alert fired: metrics-pipeline.prom-scrape-job failed 5 times in 10m (service=prometheus-scrape, severity=page). Auto-escalation scheduled in 3m. Logs show scrape errors and 503s from exporter pool.
maya: acked. I'm oncall. digging in now.
sam: seeing same alerts. Prometheus scrape error rate spiked ~03:12 UTC, exporter 503s.
toni: tag for customer-impact? any services showing missing metrics dashboards?
maya: dashboards for infra-pool show most exporter series missing since 03:10. Grafana alerts for missing critical metrics firing. Customer impact could be increased alert noise and missing SLO metrics.
alex: big scrape fanout spike on the scrape-manager pod, logs show "upstream connection reset by peer" and repeated 503 returned from exporter-proxy.
ops-runner: running `kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/scrape-manager --since=15m | grep -i 503 | wc -l` -> 412 503 entries in last 15m.
sam: checking exporter pods: `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=node-exporter -o wide` looks healthy count-wise, but CPU on exporter-proxy is 95% on two nodes.
maya: rolling restart exporter-proxy to see if that clears connection resets. Will do a canary restart on node-3.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Reminder - escalation in 2m unless acknowledged by a user.
maya: restart done on node-3 proxy. watching.
alex: after restart, 503s dropped from that node. overall 503s 412 -> 198. still high.
toni: any rate-limiting or recent deploys? I don't see deploys to exporter-proxy in the last 24h.
sam: infra autoscaler noticed CPU surge and throttled additional pods; HPA didn't scale because CPU metric was coming through the same proxy. chicken-and-egg.
maya: temporary mitigation: enable exporter-proxy circuit-breaker to 500 connections and add an immediate burst replica to the proxy deployment (+1). applying now.
ops-runner: `kubectl -n monitoring patch deploy/exporter-proxy -p '{"spec":{"replicas":3}}'` -> replicas increased to 3.
alex: circuit-breaker toggle enabled (configmap updated), saving the backend. 503s trending down -> 40 in last 5m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert auto-escalation cancelled (acknowledged by maya).
maya: marking PD incident as acknowledged and annotating with mitigation steps. I'm going to keep monitoring for 30m and then hand off to infra-ops for baseline checks.
toni: customer impact update for ops-oncall: recommend notifying a few customers using direct metrics ingestion (alpha customers) — they may have gaps between 03:10-03:40 UTC.
sam: capturing timeline and logs to paste into the incident doc. `kubectl -n monitoring exec -it svc/scrape-manager -- curl -s http://localhost/metrics | grep scrape` shows backlog metrics jumping around.
maya: quick postmortem note: root cause hypothesis: exporter-proxy saturation caused upstream resets -> prometheus scrapes failed -> alert storms and HPA blind spot. Immediate remediation: restart, scale proxy, enable circuit-breaker. Next actions: (1) add fallback scrape route to bypass proxy, (2) update HPA to use node-level metrics, (3) add synthetic-exporter probe.
alex: filing a follow-up RFC for scrape-manager fallback routing. I'll own the change.
ops-runner: scheduling a post-incident health check at 04:10 UTC to confirm no regression.
toni: I'll draft a short customer advisory note: "Short window of missing metrics detected 03:10-03:40 UTC affecting metrics dashboards and alerting. Root cause under investigation; mitigation applied. We'll follow up with full postmortem"
maya: handing off to sam (next oncall) at 03:40 UTC. Sam, please take ownership of the follow-up actions and stakeholder comms.
sam: taking handoff. I've added notes to the incident doc and created a PD incident with a link to the Slack thread.
maya: thanks everyone. leaving monitoring window open for 30m then closing unless new errors appear.
incident-bot: Deploybot: detected `scrape-manager` restart at 03:17 UTC (user=maya, reason=manual restart).
ops-runner: saved snapshots: `kubectl -n monitoring get hpa -o yaml > /tmp/hpa-snapshot-1789456789.yaml` and `kubectl -n monitoring top pod > /tmp/top-pod-1789456789.txt`. Links posted to incident doc.
sam: FYI — Grafana alert history shows missing exporters flapping until 03:35 and only stable after the replica bump; writing up customer impact and timeline now.
toni: ping @support to preempt inbound customer tickets.
maya: support pinged with the advisory draft.
alex: leaving follow-up tasks in backlog: add fallback route, HPA metrics change, synthetic probe. ETA for fixes: small routing change in 2 business days, HPA changes mid-week.
incident-bot: Incident resolved? not automatically closed.
sam: marking as monitored stable. closing paging channel in 1h if no recurrence.
maya: closing the active page now. :white_check_mark:
